Proxy media

Definition

Proxy media is lower-bandwidth synchronized copies used for editorial work while preserving links to camera originals. In a controlled workflow, its owner, version and acceptance evidence should be recorded.

Why it matters

This concept helps production teams align post decisions, handoffs and verification without relying on unstated assumptions.
